question: What can I do if i lost my student ID?
expected_answer: Students who have lost their ID card/meal card/key card should report it to Residence Life and fill out a lost ID card form. Residence Life will make you a new card for free if it is your first time losing it. Additional cards will have an associated cost to the student.

Lost IDs can also be taken to the Residence Life Office or Security, who will try to track down the owner to return it.

question: I missed the drop deadline, but I'm still getting a D. Can I get out of the class without it just becoming an F?

Contact the Dean of Students office to start the process.
